title: Reuse acquired noise information for stricter source accuracy
statement: The source correction mhat_q=q^-1 sum[g(x+G)-A G] preserves L-contraction. The acquired average noise transfers to pi_g with RMS <=sqrt(S_bar)+L A0, yielding e_t<=L e_(t-1)+c/q_t. body: A useful globally qualified candidate is not acquired for every hard source. Conditional output independence does not imply unconditional independence after shared training. False-release control is unconditional over acquisition, not posterior confidence after release. The executed fixture is affine within the candidate class; the nonlinear extension has no new numerical execution. Finite-bit/instrument warranties, rare-event consequences, critical dynamics and broad practical advantage remain separate. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: The delivered statements report completed substantive independent internal reviews at their actual scope. The separate review originals and most implementation/data artifacts are not acquired in this return; reported completion is preserved without inventing a version-bound acquired review overlay. No new scientific audit, execution or producer request is made.
